product_family.definition: Top level grouping. Hierarchy: product_family > product > capability_area.

values.name: Microsoft Copilot
values.definition: Microsoft 365 Copilot, the Copilot app, Office in Copilot, Cowork, Code, Autopilot, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and Viva Engage experiences.

values.name: Agents and agent governance
values.definition: Building, running, governing and paying for agents: Agent 365, Copilot Studio, Windows 365 for Agents.

values.name: Microsoft IQ
values.definition: Enterprise context layer: Microsoft IQ, Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Web IQ.

values.name: AI models and Microsoft Foundry
values.definition: Models (MAI, OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft-Decision), Microsoft Foundry platform services and AI silicon.

values.name: Azure infrastructure and operations
values.definition: Azure compute, operations, migration, AI infrastructure, Azure Local, sovereign cloud and Windows Server.

values.name: Data and databases
values.definition: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure databases (HorizonDB, SQL, Cosmos DB, DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, Redis).

values.name: Developer tools and GitHub
values.definition: GitHub Copilot, GitHub Enterprise, Copilot SDK and developer tooling.

values.name: Security, identity and compliance
values.definition: Microsoft Perception, Defender, Sentinel, Entra, Purview, Baseline Security Mode, MDASH and responsible AI.

values.name: Windows, Windows 365 and endpoint management
values.definition: Windows 11, Windows 365, Intune and endpoint management.

values.name: Microsoft Edge
values.definition: Edge for Business security and governed AI browsing.

values.name: Business applications
values.definition: Dynamics 365, Power Apps, Power Platform and contact centre.

values.name: Partnerships and ecosystem
values.definition: Strategic partnerships announced at Ignite (for example Salesforce).

values.name: Licensing, pricing and partner programme
values.definition: Licensing, pricing, billing, retirements and partner programme changes.

values.name: Industry solutions
values.definition: Industry-specific solutions (healthcare, financial services, public sector and others).

announcement_type.definition: What kind of news it is.

values.name: New product
values.definition: A product or service that did not exist before.

values.name: New capability
values.definition: A new feature in an existing product.

values.name: New model
values.definition: A new AI model or model family.

values.name: New version
values.definition: A new major version of an existing product.

values.name: Status change
values.definition: A move between release stages, usually preview to GA.

values.name: Update
values.definition: A bundle of improvements to an existing product.

values.name: Mixed
values.definition: One announcement with parts at different stages.

values.name: Default change
values.definition: A change to default settings or behaviour.

values.name: Pricing / licensing
values.definition: Price, SKU, billing or licence terms.

values.name: Retirement
values.definition: End of sale, end of support or removal.

values.name: Partnership
values.definition: A named commercial or technical partnership.

values.name: Industry initiative
values.definition: A multi-organisation effort or standard.

values.name: New programme
values.definition: A customer or partner programme.

values.name: Milestone
values.definition: A usage or scale figure shared on stage.

status_category.definition: Normalised release stage used for filtering. The free-text status column keeps Microsoft's own wording.

values.name: GA
values.definition: Generally available for production use.

values.name: Public preview
values.definition: Open preview, any eligible customer can try it.

values.name: Private or limited preview
values.definition: Invitation, eligibility or limited-access preview.

values.name: Preview (stage not stated)
values.definition: Microsoft says preview without saying public or private.

values.name: Frontier
values.definition: Microsoft's early-access programme for Copilot and agents.

values.name: Coming soon
values.definition: Announced with no current access.

values.name: Mixed
values.definition: Parts of the announcement sit at different stages; see the status column.

values.name: Licensing change
values.definition: A dated licensing or billing change.

values.name: Retirement
values.definition: Being retired or removed.

values.name: Announced
values.definition: Announced with no stage given.

values.name: Milestone
values.definition: A figure, not a product change.

audience.definition: Primary reader the announcement is aimed at.

values.name: Business decision makers
values.definition: Budget holders and leaders deciding on spend and value.

values.name: IT pros and admins
values.definition: People who deploy, manage and govern.

values.name: Security teams
values.definition: SOC, identity, data security and compliance.

values.name: Developers
values.definition: People who build apps, agents and integrations.

values.name: Data professionals
values.definition: Analysts, data engineers and BI developers.

values.name: End users
values.definition: Everyday users of Copilot and Microsoft 365.

values.name: Partners
values.definition: Microsoft partners, CSPs and MSPs.

industry.definition: Industry focus where stated; most items are cross-industry.

values.name: Cross-industry
values.definition: No specific industry.

values.name: Healthcare
values.definition: Clinical and health organisations.

values.name: Financial services
values.definition: Banks, insurers, capital markets.

values.name: Public sector
values.definition: Government, defence, sovereign requirements.

values.name: Retail
values.definition: Retail and consumer goods.

values.name: Manufacturing
values.definition: Manufacturing and industrial.

ignite_scope.definition: Whether the item was announced at Ignite or is adjacent news from the same period.

values.name: Ignite 2026
values.definition: Announced at Ignite 2026 (live news, Book of News or Ignite-dated official blogs).

values.name: Adjacent (November partner announcements)
values.definition: Partner Center or licensing news published in November 2026.

values.name: Adjacent (28 Oct 2026, pre-Ignite)
values.definition: Published before Ignite but directly relevant.

values.name: Ignite window (docs)
values.definition: Documented in product docs during the Ignite window.

verification.definition: Which kind of source the row rests on.

values.name: Book of News
values.definition: Confirmed in the Ignite 2026 Book of News.

values.name: Live news + official blog
values.definition: Confirmed on the live news blog and an official blog.

values.name: Official blog
values.definition: Confirmed on an official Microsoft, Azure, Windows, Dynamics 365 or Tech Community blog.

values.name: Microsoft AI blog
values.definition: Confirmed on microsoft.ai news.

values.name: Book of News + Microsoft AI blog
values.definition: Confirmed in the Book of News and on microsoft.ai.

values.name: Live news + Microsoft AI blog
values.definition: Confirmed on the live news blog and on microsoft.ai.

values.name: Live news + Microsoft Source
values.definition: Confirmed on the live news blog and Microsoft Source.

values.name: GitHub changelog
values.definition: Confirmed on the GitHub changelog.

values.name: Partner Center announcements
values.definition: Confirmed on Microsoft Learn Partner Center announcements.

values.name: Official docs (Defender for Office 365 what's new)
values.definition: Confirmed in Microsoft Learn docs.

values.name: Parallel deep research (official blog)
values.definition: Found by Parallel deep research citing an official blog; to be re-read on the next run.

region.definition: Region availability where Microsoft states it; otherwise 'Not stated'.

values.name: Not stated
values.definition: Microsoft did not give regions.

values.name: Named regions
values.definition: See the region column.
